title: Cinema Sundays: Matilda
seo_title: Cinema Sundays: Matilda at Gillioz Theatre
description: Cinema Sundays presents a free showing of the film Matilda, based on the Roald Dahl work about a gifted girl with telekinesis who stands up to the strict principal Agatha Trunchbull. The screening includes a free non-alcoholic beverage and popcorn, with general admission tickets available at the Gillioz Box Office starting at noon the day of the show. It takes place Sunday, November 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 1 PM.
